transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's a pleasure to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, what brings me in is... my talking gets all mixed up. 

I try to explain things to people, like—I'll start talking about the keys, and then the jail, and then the prayer rug, and then chess pieces. I just jump around, I guess. And people just look at me and tell me they cannot follow what I am saying. So, that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling unusually energized, irritable, or extremely down in the dumps during the periods when your speech has been difficult to follow?

Yeah, I'd say energized. There were times recently when I was only sleeping maybe a few hours a night. I had all these big plans for the buildings I clean, figuring out all these new ways to run things. 

But during those same times... that's when my talking gets really bad, and other things happen, too. Like, I also heard this voice coming from the air vents. And I was just... I felt completely sure that the hallway lights were sending out warnings about me. So, yeah, it all kind of happens at the same time.
Have there been any times when you experienced those voices or the feeling that the lights were sending warnings, even when you were not feeling energized or having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, there have been. Um, I've had some calmer weeks where I wasn't feeling especially high, and I wasn't deeply depressed either. Just kind of regular. 

But even during that time, for more than two weeks, I still heard that man talking in the vents. And I still fully believed that people in the building were signaling about me. So, yeah, those things still happen even when my energy and sleep are fine.
How long have you been dealing with these voices and the feeling that people were signaling about you in total—has it been going on for at least six months?
Yeah, it's been longer than six months. Um... I'd say the voices and those fixed worries about being watched or marked, they've been with me for about a year and a half in total.

Looking back at that year and a half, would you say that the times you felt unusually energized or had trouble sleeping took up most of that time, or were those periods relatively short compared to the time you felt more like your usual self?

I'd say it took up most of the time. Yeah, for most of that year and a half since this all started, I've been stuck in those really keyed-up stretches. It's not just a few days here and there. Most of the time, I'm just... talking way too much, taking on these impossible cleaning plans for the building, and feeling completely driven. It's like my motor is stuck on high and I just cannot slow down.

During those times when you felt so energized and had those big plans, did your behavior become so extreme that you were unable to work, ended up in the hospital, or caused serious problems with other people?

Yeah, it has caused a lot of problems. Um... I've missed shifts and actually lost some of my cleaning work because of it. I've also stopped going to the mosque and stopped joining in on family gatherings. People tell me they just can't rely on me, or they don't understand me when I get like that. And... yeah, there have been times when things got so extreme and I was unsafe enough that other people actually had to call for emergency help.
